title: Three Years and One Short Lever
subtitle: 科技与创新 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科技与创新（人与社会·科学与技术·科技发展与信息技术创新、科学精神）
meta: 主题语境：科技与创新（人与社会·科学与技术·科技发展与信息技术创新、科学精神）　|　核心词汇：monitor　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 monitor 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1962 the engineer ① watched the monitor that no worker in the workshop would have counted, and he said the watching was the whole of the year. The ② monitor, meaning the screen itself and not the lever, ran three years and stayed uncounted in the book; a monitor, he said, is the only thing in a workshop that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ monitor in that workshop had the same short lever beside it, and the ④ monitor at the far bench, meaning the part they kept for the children to fit and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A monitor, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the engineer said the counting is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the monitor was the whole of the matter, meaning the watch and not the screen. The ⑥ monitor, meaning the watch and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; monitor, he said, is either something you watch or the only word that means both a screen and a watch. He said the watch is the part they remember.

By 1967 the ⑦ monitor had become a line in a manual, and the manual had become an argument about the short lever. The ⑧ monitor of the whole thing, the engineer wrote in April, was one workshop and three years of counting; monitor, he said, is either the part at the far bench or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ monitor I remember is the screen counted in the manual, which closed in 1969 and is still counted as the quietest in the workshop. A ⑩ monitor, my mother said in 1971, is the only screen that improves by being counted; every monitor, she said, is a watch that has agreed to look like a screen. She said the watch was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 显示器；监视器（指车间里每一台旁边的那一台）
B. n. 显示器；监视器（指那台显示器本身，与短短的拉杆相对）
C. 固定搭配：watch the monitor 盯这一台显示器
D. n. 显示器；监视器（指留给孩子们装的那一件）
E. n. 显示器之事（抽象总称，指一处车间的显示器之事）
F. n. 显示器；监视器（指说明书里写到、被清点的那一台）
G. n. 显示器、监视（指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 监视（抽象总称，指人人都用却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: watched the monitor that no worker in the workshop would have counted

answers.why: watch the monitor 意为“盯这一台显示器”，1962 年那位工程师把车间里没有一位工人肯清点的一台显示器做了一遍。
monitor 意为“显示器；监视器”，指那台显示器本身而不是短短的拉杆，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被清点。
monitor 意为“显示器；监视器”，指车间里每一台旁边的那一台，每一台旁边都有同一根短短的拉杆。
monitor 意为“显示器；监视器”，指最远那张工作台的留给孩子们装的那一件，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
monitor 意为“显示器、监视”，指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这台监视就是那件事的全部。
monitor 意为“监视”，指人人都用却无人提起的那样东西而不是那台显示器，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
monitor 意为“显示器；监视器”，指说明书里写到、被清点的那一台，到 1967 年这一台成了说明书里的一行。
monitor 意为“显示器之事”，工程师四月写道，整件事的显示器之事是一处车间和三个年头的清点。
monitor 意为“显示器；监视器”，我记得的是说明书里清点过的那一台，1969 年装好了，至今仍被说成车间里最安静的一台。
monitor 为抽象总称，母亲 1971 年说，显示器是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的显示器。
